svg.desc: 11 resources (8 spatial cards, 3 logical resources in 3 group cards) · 13 relationships Thin solid: dependency. Dashed: association. Thick dotted: connection. Nested boxes: containment. Edge color preserves the Terraform action when available. Service label backgrounds: orange = compute; green = storage; blue = network; red = IAM; gray = unclassified.
